usage_requirements: Pooling: CLS token (first token) — NOT mean pooling; verified in repo 1_Pooling/config.json (pooling_mode_cls_token=true, pooling_mode_mean_tokens=false). Using mean pooling silently degrades quality.
Normalize embeddings (L2) before cosine/dot-product similarity (normalize_embeddings=True in FlagEmbedding/sentence-transformers).

Optional query-side instruction for short-query retrieval: prepend 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: ' to queries only; passages/documents never get a prefix. v1.5 works without the instruction with only a slight performance trade-off — pick whichever performs better on your task.
Max input 512 tokens; longer inputs must be truncated/chunked.
known_issues: Absolute similarity scores are not calibrated: model card advises relying on relative score ordering for ranking/filtering, not fixed absolute thresholds. v1.5 was specifically released to fix the overly narrow similarity distribution of bge-*-en v1.0.
Asymmetric usage (query prefix on queries only) is easy to get wrong in pipelines; inconsistent prefixing between indexing and querying degrades retrieval silently.

FlagEmbedding GitHub issues for this model family are mostly about fine-tuning/training (e.g., loss plateau #744, multi-GPU hang #1482) rather than inference-time defects; no widely reported inference bugs specific to bge-small-en-v1.5 found.
unknowns: independent_mteb_leaderboard_verification (benchmark numbers taken from the model card's own model-index metadata; the current MTEB leaderboard app could not be independently fetched, so all scores are flagged self_reported)
